raw_affiliation: I am an Associate Professor of Global Strategy in the Department of Strategic Management & Entrepreneurship, Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University. raw_affiliation: Claudia Gabbioneta is Chair in Accounting and Management at the School for Business and Society, University of York, UK.
